title: Correct force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate F = Eq, yielding 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ N.

title: Correct work magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate W = Fd, yielding 4.0 × 10⁻⁵ J.

title: Force direction understanding
description: Important: The response should indicate the force direction is along the field for a positive charge.

title: Work sign interpretation
description: Important: The response should correctly relate the work sign to the direction of motion relative to the force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The response includes correct units (N, J) and shows unit analysis.

title: Misapplied work formula
description: Pitfall: Using W = qEd without confirming constant force and straight-line motion, or misplacing the sign.

title: Exponent arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Making errors in multiplying powers of ten (e.g., 10⁴ × 10⁻⁸ ≠ 10⁻⁴).
